outputs.summary: Root cause: .terminal-host did not clip its children. xterm's grid (until the 80 ms debounced refit) and its helper textarea (left at the old cursor row after an unfocused height shrink) overflowed the host, making app-main (overflow:auto) scrollable. Its scrollbar took 10px from the pane (PTY got 227 instead of 228 cols), and one wheel tick over the terminal scrolled the whole pane up 291px, pushing the header and output away and leaving a dead strip below the grid, with the input line out of place. Fix: overflow: clip on .terminal-host (terminalPane.css). The fit / ResizeObserver / PTY resize path was already correct and is now pinned by tests. Reproduced and verified in the built app over CDP with a fixture CLI and with real PowerShell under ConPTY. Caveat: the worker could not reproduce the grid/PTY failing to follow the size on current code (it refit at every size before the fix too); it did not run Claude Code or OMP, so the person should re-test with their agent.
